items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: We had a lot of young musicians in the band that was very talented; Mangual, Vidal, Paquito.

ctx.x: ..... and really, I was a success. No because it was me, it just the band was cooking and, you know, a

well-rehearsed band and very enthusiastic. We had a lot of young musicians in the band that was very talented; Mangual, Vidal, Paquito. Rene Hernandez was young, tremendous musician, tremendous arranger.
That's right, Rene was in the band.
